invariants.name: one interface header
invariants.rule: The domain declares its capability surface in exactly one normative interface file. The header contains no implementation and names no implementation.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: interface file present, declared in descriptor, contains no function body

invariants.name: registry, not call sites
invariants.rule: Implementations are bound by a registry. No caller names an implementation. Deleting the registry must break binding, never compilation of callers.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: no implementation id appears outside registry/ and descriptor

invariants.name: ports include mock and template
invariants.rule: The same interface is realised on N substrates. Two are mandatory: mock (runs with nothing attached) and template (the empty port a third party fills).
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: ports[] contains mock and template

invariants.name: the harness is the definition
invariants.rule: Conformance is an executable suite, not prose. Every condition carries a measurable acceptance criterion with units. A condition whose limit is unknown is written 'not established' — an invented limit is worse than an absent one.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: every condition has criterion+unit or the exact string 'not established'

invariants.name: one verb table, many surfaces
invariants.rule: skills/verbs.json is the single source for every agent surface. A surface is generated, never hand-written.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: verbs.json present, each verb has args+returns+preconditions

invariants.name: closed attachment set
invariants.rule: Foreign systems attach at a fixed enumerated set of points or not at all. A new kind of attachment is a contract change, not a patch.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: INTEGRATION.md enumerates points; descriptor.attachment_points matches

invariants.name: roadmap is data
invariants.rule: Work is packages/tracks/milestones in JSON, validated in `make check`. Every package declares dependencies; packages with none are startable immediately by anyone.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate + validate_roadmap: ids unique, deps resolve, no cycles, >=1 zero-dependency package

invariants.name: measure, then claim
invariants.rule: A performance, coverage or completeness claim requires a recorded measurement in the same commit. One package, one pull request, one proof.
invariants.checked_by: pr_gate: claim vocabulary in diff requires a budgets.json entry and a measurement artifact

invariants.name: the engine is common, the workflow is not
invariants.rule: Domains share this skeleton and NOTHING else. Each domain authors its own purpose, contract, context, state model, invariants, failure modes, evidence requirements, workflow and artifact model. Reuse the smallest primitive. Architecture is never inferred from code reuse.
invariants.checked_by: spine_leak: no domain's distinctive nouns may appear in another domain's descriptor or prose

invariants.name: nothing pretends
invariants.rule: Built, wired-unproven, and not-built are three different states and are reported as three. No stub that looks alive. Absence is reported with where it was looked for.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate: descriptor.state values in {built,wired_unproven,not_built}; no other value accepted

invariants.name: adopt before inventing; vendor without drifting
invariants.rule: Where an external standard already covers a need, the spine emits that standard and records what it does NOT cover. Where a sovereign domain must vendor a shared primitive rather than import it, a behavioural drift check proves the copy still answers as the reference does.
invariants.checked_by: spine_validate + core.drift: spine/standards.json is present and every entry names what it replaces and what it does not do; vendored primitives agree with core on a shared vector set
